text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Japan Dirt Derby. Shinko 
Windy gets heckled, but holds back today. 
She will definitely not talk back.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To show the world how cool I can be and 
fulfill my ambition, I won't let headwinds 
like this bring me down!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, Biko Pegasus was on the verge 
of giving up after failing to improve her 
times. She then watched Shinko Windy's 
race on the TV broadcast.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy stood proudly in the paddock, 
braving the jeers. Biko Pegasus eagerly 
anticipated what kind of race she would 
run.
